notice.en: Synthetic data: a bank invented for the case whose annual loss distribution is known by construction; the LDCE medians shape it and it describes no real bank.
notice.es: Datos sintéticos: un banco inventado para el caso cuya distribución de pérdida anual se conoce por construcción; las medianas de la LDCE lo moldean y no describe a ningún banco real.

source.title: Results from the 2008 Loss Data Collection Exercise for Operational Risk

frequency.statistic: median across banks of the losses of EUR 20,000 or more per year per EUR billion of consolidated assets

caveat.en: Medians of per-bank percentiles are not the percentiles of any one bank; the statistics calibrate a synthetic bank and describe no real one.
caveat.es: Las medianas de percentiles por banco no son los percentiles de ningun banco; las estadisticas calibran un banco sintetico y no describen a uno real.

variants.true_mean_reason: the tail index is 1 or more: the severity has an infinite mean, so the annual loss has no mean

description.en: Bucket 1 banks have ILM = 1 unless national discretion includes their losses.
description.es: Los bancos del tramo 1 tienen ILM = 1 salvo que la discrecion nacional incluya sus perdidas.

description.en: Supervisors may set ILM = 1 for every bank of the jurisdiction; disclosure stays.
description.es: Los supervisores pueden fijar ILM = 1 para todos los bancos de la jurisdiccion; la divulgacion se mantiene.

description.en: Under 5 years of loss data (10 are required, 5 are the transitional minimum) capital is the BIC only.
description.es: Con menos de 5 anos de datos de perdida (se piden 10, 5 es el minimo transitorio) el capital es solo el BIC.

sma.reference: dossier 01 section F (OPE25, in force 2023-01-01, published 2024-07-05)

prior.mapping: GPD fitted to the scenario points by least squares on the log excess quantiles; alpha_s = 1 / xi_s is the prior mean and the parametric-bootstrap 90 percent interval of alpha_s the expert interval; the Gamma shape and rate solve the mean and the interval mass (decision D4); the scenario frequencies are redrawn as Poisson over the years of the history (decision D6); the bootstrap seed is the first of 0 to 99 whose 100 refits all lie inside the search bounds of the engine

scenarios.reference: dossier 05 F.5; Shevchenko and Wuthrich (2006), J. Operational Risk 1(3):3-26
